scientific_integrity: The formulas follow from a direct boundary-space proof. Exhaustive field checks and a published nonsingular specialization serve as corroboration and are not infinite proofs or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Rank counts apply over all finite fields; ordinary character counts are for odd characteristic. No claims about orbit classification, all graph families, or scheme-theoretic ranks. A broad previously published bounded-pathwidth transfer might cover the claim, though none was identified in the targeted comparison.
title: Four-state ladder character-degree transfer over finite fields
